subject: Way to call R functions in C in Stan models

messages.author: bc11fbb928eb77ff
messages.subject: Way to call R functions in C in Stan models
parts:
Dear Colleagues,

I would like to call R functions in C (more specifically the function "qbeta") in Stan models: is this possible? Is it explained somewhere in the documentation?

I can call it in other C functions used outside STAN provided I include headers realated to R in my C program: is it possible in STAN?

Sincerely,

Frédéric Gosselin
Irstea
France

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Way to call R functions in C in Stan models
parts:
On Tuesday, November 8, 2016 at 5:14:45 AM UTC-5, Frédéric Gosselin wrote:
I would like to call R functions in C (more specifically the function "qbeta") in Stan models: is this possible? Is it explained somewhere in the documentation?

I can call it in other C functions used outside STAN provided I include headers realated to R in my C program: is it possible in STAN?

It is not currently possible to call functions in other libraries from Stan programs. Nor would calling plain C functions handle the autodifferentiation.

I would recommend instead using the Kumaraswamy distribution, which is similar to the beta distribution but has a closed form quantile function. If you really need to use the beta quantile function its power-series would have to be implemented in the Stan math library.

Ben
